span.div:
1. Check cooldown: last scaling action > 10 min ago
2. Validate: quorum will be maintained after change
3. Execute: etcdctl member add/remove
4. Verify: endpoint health check after change
5. Update load balancer or DNS if needed
6 Notify, update deployment record

Scale-Up Rules
cpu > 70% for 5m
latency > 100ms
conn > 80% limit

conn < 30% for 30m

span.div:
Cooldown: 10 minutes between scaling actions
Max scale-up: +1 node per 10 minutes
Max scale-down: -1 node per 30 minutes
